close_reason: documented known limitation; Cow<'static, str> migration deferred to v0.3
description:
pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:139-146 — the de_static_str function leaks memory:
  `Ok(Box::leak(s.into_boxed_str()))`

The doc comment documents this extensively, including a warning for long-running services. However:

1. The serde bound on EvaluationReport and Finding requires 'de: 'static (documented), which means callers using serde_json::from_str (not from_slice) with a leaked string are the expected pattern. The test in report.rs does exactly Box::leak (line 305).

2. For production use in a cert-policy daemon that continuously deserializes findings from a message queue, each unique LintResult detail string creates a permanent leak.

The doc comment says to file an issue to accelerate Cow<'static, str> migration. This is the filed issue.

Severity: P3 (not a correctness bug; will cause memory issues only in specific deployment patterns; documented).

Suggested fix: Migrate LintResult::Warn/Error/Fatal detail field from &'static str to Cow<'static, str>. This is a breaking change, so needs a semver bump or a deprecation path.
title: de_static_str memory leak in serde feature: unbounded growth in long-running services
